```{r}
# Installing packages "pacman"
if (!require("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
}

p_load(fredr, tidyverse)

# Setting API key --FRED
fredr_set_key("605ebe942e732ed6557666cc5a417533") # you should make your API key public

# Will use US unemployment rate and CPI data
unrate <- fredr(series_id = "UNRATE", observation_start = as.Date("2000-01-01"))
cpi <- fredr(series_id = "CPIAUCSL", observation_start = as.Date("2000-01-01"))

# Plot 1: Unemployment rate over time
p1 <- ggplot(unrate, aes(x = date, y = value)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "US Unemployment Rate", y = "Percent", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: CPI Inflation year-over-year
cpi_yoy <- cpi %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(inflation = (value / lag(value, 12) - 1) * 100)

p2 <- ggplot(cpi_yoy, aes(x = date, y = inflation)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "US CPI Inflation (YoY %)", y = "Percent", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2)

# Save plots
ggsave("unemployment.png", p1, width = 8, height = 5)
ggsave("inflation.png", p2, width = 8, height = 5)
```
